title: Buyer Closing Extension Addendum (Home Purchase Agreement) — Desk Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** A buyer-requested closing extension moves the scheduled closing date of a Home Purchase Agreement in status closing scheduled later by a number of calendar days; the buyer signs the extension addendum, the extension counts toward the buyer's closing extensions, and its closing extension fee is charged when the request is received. Where the buyer asks for the extension after the scheduled closing date has passed, the new closing date is set only after the ledger carries closing delay per diem for every day of buyer delay before the extension request was received.

Stated as a condition on the records: for a request received after the scheduled closing date has passed, the new closing date waits until the agreement ledger shows closing delay per diem covering each day of buyer delay that came before the day the request was received.

**Situation of use and capability.** With `sign_closing_extension_addendum_c0ddd0a3` the buyer signs a closing extension addendum on their own Home Purchase Agreement. One call moves the agreement's scheduled closing date later by the stated number of calendar days and counts one more buyer-requested closing extension on the agreement. The buyer sees the new scheduled closing date on the agreement and in the signed addendum receipt.

**How it is invoked.** This is the buyer's own tool. The representative unlocks `sign_closing_extension_addendum_c0ddd0a3` and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs the addendum by running it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_id` | The reference number identifying the buyer's Home Purchase Agreement, as given to the buyer by the representative from the purchase agreement record | Identifier |
| `extension_days` | How many calendar days later the scheduled closing date moves, counted from the current scheduled closing date | Positive integer number of days |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a dictionary rendered as text with: `status` ("signed" when the addendum took effect), `purchase_id`, `previous_closing_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the scheduled closing date replaced), `new_closing_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the scheduled closing date now in force) and `closing_extensions_used` (the integer count of buyer-requested closing extensions now written on the agreement). The tool returns an error when no Home Purchase Agreement carries the given reference number, and an error when the agreement has no scheduled closing date to move; in either case nothing changes.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** On an agreement whose scheduled closing date is 2026-06-12, a signed addendum with `extension_days` 10 returns `previous_closing_date` 2026-06-12 and `new_closing_date` 2026-06-22, and `closing_extensions_used` one higher than before.
